text_rows.value: So intent is their patrol, these Koolakamba pay us no heed. Perhaps we must get closer.
Could one of you not stop your pacing for but a moment? Hello? Anyone?
Perhaps this calls for a louder voice. Just march up to the Koolakamba and demand their attention.
Oh, you just want to talk? We thought you were attacking. You should speak up more. Well, come on then.
The Malughast lives again? Oh man, that's not good. I'm feeling a universal contingency coming on here.
Do not panic, friend. Simply tell us what you know of this Malughast.
Malughast is just what we called it. Not sure where the name came from. Just one of those words whispered through the ages.
But generations ago, it emerged from the ground and tore through the Wilds. It took all of our strongest warriors to stop it.
How, man, how did they accomplish this?
Got me. But I know who could find out. The Doctor Witch. If you want to stop the Malughast, you must let her in.
I see. Thank you, friend. Come, Wizard. I know what we must do.
The Doctor Witch is a dreadful thing, Wizard. It is said wherever she goes, sickness and poverty follow.
